subject: planner: fix the issue about simplify outer join to inner join (#51750)
summary: Removed recursive calls in `simplifyOuterJoin()` so outer->inner conversion is decided only at the current join node (avoids applying parent predicates to embedded joins). Added an integration test for #51560 demonstrating stable results with `IN (...)` lists containing `NULL`. Later history up to `upstream/master` keeps this non-recursive behavior (logic moved but not reverted).
